name: Browse the ADMAX App Store and launch Admax Social
description: Verifies visitors can navigate to the dedicated app store and launch the featured social application.
steps: Choose App Store in the navigation
Review the featured Admax Social listing
expected: The App Store section is reachable from navigation and its featured link opens the existing Admax Social application.

name: Search and filter apps in the store
description: Verifies visitors can find published apps using the search field and category filters on a mobile viewport.
setup: Publish at least two apps in different categories
steps: Search for an app by part of its name
Clear the search and choose All
expected: The app catalogue updates to show only matching apps and returns to the full catalogue when filters are cleared.

name: Admin adds a project that remains listed
description: Verifies the authorized administrator can publish an app listing and it remains visible after reload.
steps: Sign in using the authorized portfolio administrator account
Choose Add project and enter a title, description, category and HTTPS app URL
expected: The new app appears in the public App Store after refresh with its title, description and launch link.

name: Reject invalid project details
description: Verifies incomplete project details and insecure links cannot be published.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Enter a title and description but use an http:// URL
expected: A validation message appears and the invalid app is not added to the catalogue.

name: Admin edits and removes a project
description: Verifies an administrator can update an app listing and remove it with confirmation.
setup: Create a portfolio project named Sample App with a valid HTTPS URL
steps: Edit Sample App and change its description
Refresh and verify the changed description
Choose delete and confirm the removal
expected: The edited description persists, then the confirmed deletion removes the app from the store.

name: Upload and display a project cover image
description: Verifies an administrator can upload a supported cover image and see it on the app card.
setup: Create a portfolio project named Cover Test with a valid HTTPS URL
steps: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP cover image no larger than 3 MB
expected: The uploaded cover image is displayed on the Cover Test app card.
